entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Hm... There are twice as many[n]people here as there are normally.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: But the white noise caused by[n]the crowd is quite pleasant, to be[n]fair. It helps me hone my senses.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: If I close my eyes, it's almost as[n]if I'm floating through space...
This noise is relaxing?[clr 27]
Glad you're enjoying this.
There's no sound in space.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Absolute silence is too[n]straightforward.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Don't you feel oddly stiff when[n]confined to a soundless room and[n]forced to face your true self?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: A moderate amount of noise helps[n]me melt into the world around me.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Indeed. There is much to learn[n]in observing the work of others.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Interpretation depends on the[n]state of the observer as well. It[n]is as though art itself is alive.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: ...It is more a matter of[n]your imagination.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: The sensation of melding into[n]something larger than yourself[n]is quite difficult to attain.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Honestly, I sense something[n]has changed within me due[n]to our visit here...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It seems my attitude toward[n]art has shifted in some way.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Ah, yes. I'd like to show you[n]one of my favorite works.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: A piece that makes you see[n]something new upon each visit[n]is immensely rare...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I look forward to viewing what I[n]may glean from it today too. I[n]hope you feel the same, [fName].

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: That painting from earlier has[n]actually been made into a statue.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: This may be a mere[n]replica, but I would like[n]you to have it, [fName].

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: My artistic urges are flaring[n]up... Let us return home.
